title: The response part is treated exactly as the request part, and a member not given is no slot.
why: behavioural spec 'response': identical treatment to 'request' — 'status' and 'body' by the 'literal' rules, 'headers' by the name-to-list rule with names lower-cased. The interaction declares no request, so 'parts' carries no 'request' slot.
